name: Surah Maryam
summary:
Experience the recitation of Surah Maryam, the nineteenth chapter of the Holy Quran, in a deeply immersive virtual reality environment designed for Meta Quest.

This VR experience offers a calm and distraction-free space where you can listen to and reflect on the verses of Surah Maryam. The thoughtfully designed virtual environment and high-quality audio create a peaceful atmosphere for focus, contemplation, and spiritual connection with the Quran.
